pages.title: Flerovium Ingot
pages.text: Element 114, a superheavy metal held together by a near-magic number of protons. Real flerovium lasts seconds; this ingot lasts indefinitely because its neutron count sits right on the island. It is improbably dense and faintly warm.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The island of stability predicts superheavy nuclei that live long. I fed r-process clusters and neutronium into the Nuclide Forge with muons to tighten the nuclei and quark-gluon plasma to supply neutrons, and something came out that did not immediately decay.
Made in $(item)Nuclide Forge$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Island of Stability.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Dimensional Residue, Transcendent Metal Ingot, Transcendent Plasma, Unbihexium Ingot.
